description.fallback: Jonathan falls with Dio all the way down to the first floor of the burning mansion. Jonathan reflects on how Dio has tortured him, and how up to this moment he has lost everything but his own life because of Dio. With nothing else to live for, JoJo is more than willing to die to stop Dio's ambitions.
